body: Agreement 5 of 10 from the Dimensional x AuDHD findings comparison (Overlap tab, Jayarr — Dimensional Profile). Matches: Finding #6 (intent aims attention) and the Why-log 'inconsistency' hole. Nature: consistency between two self-reports (the findings and a self-report app), not confirmation. Levels measured from the app's 5-segment bars.
doc_ref: Jayarr — Dimensional Profile (Claude Docs), Overlap tab
plain: Conscientiousness Low alongside Time Management, Competence and Keeping Busy High fits capacity that is there when aimed by intent. Whether it varies with load is untested (see run-stopping-engine-20261030-trait-language-state-effects).
status: consistency with AuDHD findings; content not ruled
